sections.label: Head
Extremities
sections.text:
Stiff limbs ; tonic cramps. Paralysis.
When walking, every jar seems repeated in the head.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Chilly in open air. Feverish in evening.
Sweat during stool, with creeping sensation, with abund-
ant urine. Pain in liver during fever.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Cough. Hoarse voice ; throat irritated ;
chest oppressed, causing insomnia. Stabbing in chest.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Acrid, foul, retained, abundant. Polyuria.
Sudden inability to hold it in women. Nocturnal in-
continence. Enuresis.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Excoriation between fingers and toes ; pust-
ules on thighs; nodes on forehead.
